name: VerusBridge

classification.summary: Verus submitImports accepted a crafted partialtransactionproof/MMR proof that bypassed VerusProof validation, minting fake ETH/tBTC/USDC imports.

sources.note: onchain review: 0x71518580f36feceffe0721f06ba4703218cd7f63 is the Verus Delegator, an unverified module-registry proxy that delegatecalls an address[] of 11 module contracts and emits no upgrade event at all, so the code history was recovered in Tier 2 by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt over the array (length slot 13 = 11, data at keccak256(13)+i) between creation block 18272987 (2023-10-03) and each incident block. Last change per module before incident 1 (block 25118335): contracts[7] 2023-11-03T17:11:11Z (block 18492941), contracts[2] 2024-03-21T22:05:59Z (block 19485889), contracts[9] 2024-12-07T20:40:35Z (block 21353057), contracts[10] 2024-12-07T20:43:47Z (block 21353072), contracts[5] 2026-01-09T20:55:35Z (block 24199650) and contracts[0]/[1]/[6]/[8] 2026-02-28T16:29:47Z (block 24556629, tx 0xc17ab86af35ac0f37a3001e249ba8176e53189151601d50eddc427cacf11ddba from the Verus upgrade signer 0x896e59efcbec700bc9f447af7018bdc5ca1fa5ab, selector 0x60cd61a5); contracts[3] and [4] were untouched since deployment. Age measured from the latest of those, 2026-02-28, rather than the 2023 Delegator deployment
